 Published Nov. 6, 2026 4:42 a.m. ET share facebook x reddit link Associated Press Troy Trojans (0-1) at Florida State Seminoles (1-0)
 Tallahassee, Florida; Friday, 7 p.m. EST
 BOTTOM LINE: Florida State hosts Troy after Sebastian Rancik scored 25 points in Florida State's 113-69 victory over the Florida A&M Rattlers.
 Florida State went 18-15 overall with an 11-6 record at home during the 2025-26 season. The Seminoles allowed opponents to score 77.9 points per game and shoot 44.5% from the field last season.
 Troy went 22-12 overall with a 9-7 record on the road a season ago. The Trojans averaged 79.3 points per game while shooting 44.6% from the field and 33.3% from behind the arc last season.
